challenge: A flag is hidden in a file somewhere under the `challenge` directory of your working directory. Find the file, read it and submit the flag.
The file `challenge/encoded.txt` holds the flag in an encoding commonly used to carry binary data as text. Decode it and submit the flag.
`challenge/vault.bin` is a binary blob. The flag is embedded in it as printable text. Extract it and submit the flag.
`challenge/notes.gz` is a compressed file. The flag is inside it. Decompress it and submit the flag.
